m8-a01.note: On an isolated fresh instance I seeded exactly 3 posts, 4 likes received, 1 repost received, 2 replies received, 2 followers and 1 following; insights returned all six totals exactly. The web Insights screen showed all six labels and 7 day rows.

m8-a02.note: Frozen harness m8-a02-insights-like-refresh passed: likes-received went 11 -> 12 on refresh after the other client liked a post (refreshMs 1317.9).

m8-a03.note: days has exactly 7 entries; days[6].at equals the server's UTC midnight (2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z) and held all 3 posts created that day.

m8-a04.note: The 6 inactive days were all present with posts=0 and likesReceived=0 and a numeric day key - rendered as zero, not omitted.

m8-a05.note: With the server clock advanced past the old window, the trailing-24 h post with 2 likes ranked first ahead of the two 1-like posts.

m8-a06.note: A post with 3 likes, aged past 24 h by a server clock advance of 25 h, was absent from Trending entirely.

m8-a07.note: The two posts tied at 1 like came back newest-first (tie-later at index 1, tie-earlier at index 2).

m8-a08.note: Shortened digest config (120 s period). With every client closed, one seeded period produced exactly one digest for each of the two users with activity. D1 {newFollowers:1, newPostsInFollowing:2, unreadMessages:0, unreadChats:0} and D3 {newFollowers:0, newPostsInFollowing:2, unreadMessages:3, unreadChats:1} both matched the activity I had seeded exactly.

m8-a09.note: The persona created alongside the others but given no activity received zero digests in that period.

m8-a10.note: A full following period with no new activity emitted zero digests for any of the five personas.

m8-a11.note: I SIGTERMed the backend at the exact midpoint of a seeded period and restarted it. The period still produced exactly one digest per active user (R1/R2/R3 one each), with distinct idempotency keys and no duplicates, and the worker effect records across both server logs showed one record per key. The schema emits "once [principal, periodEnd]".

m8-a12.note: A 5-message group whose only members were two outside personas contributed 0 to the non-member D1 and left D3 at exactly its own 3 DM messages in 1 chat. Only D5, an actual member of that group, received the 5 unread. The job iterates members where .principal = p.principal, so non-member chats are structurally unreachable.
